maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: On the right-side muzzle, two primary spots in the uppermost row are positioned dorsally to the first two spots of the secondary row. On the left-side muzzle, a single spot is positioned dorsally above the interval between the first and second spots of the secondary row.

other_distinctive_markers: The image is a bilateral composite comparing the 'right' and 'left' maxillary vibrissae patterns for individual identification.
